name: Asagi
source:
… Do not worry about me."

"If you have time to worry about useless things, then place the Princess first,"

The guardian of the Dianthus chinensis Kamon, and the Butterfly under Orpheus.
Always has the mission set in her mind and does not understand any jokes.

She hates being treated as a woman
